procedural_matters: ITA 11 is reppresented by Emilia Salvatore FRA 6 is reppresented by Alex Mostini
facts: At the moment of incident the wind was 7-8 knots and the lake water was almost calm
ITA 11 and FRA 6 were sailing on the first beat (mid-beat) to winward, near the port layline, on opposite tack, in race
ITA 11 was on starboard and FRA 6 on port
ITA 11 and FRA 6 were on a converging course FRA 6 and ITA 11 were sailing quite the same speed and FRA 6 a bit ahed of ITA 11

When the bow of ITA 11 was at less than half boat length from the starboard midship of FRA 6, ITA 6 bore away and passed behind the stearn of FRA 6. The distance between ITA 11 bow and FRA 6 stern was approximately 50 cm
conclusions: There was reasonable doubt that FRA 6 could have crossed, if ITA 11 had not taken avoiding action (see WS Case 50).
FRA 6 on port failed to keep clear of ITA on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
decision: Protest uphold and FRA6 is DSQ in race 9
